purpose: Convert provider failures into deterministic recovery routes, stop unchanged retries, preserve independent-lane progress and auto-continue when fresh proof crosses a provider gate.

circuit_breakers.google: Do not repeat the same invalid WIF token exchange until provider/admin state changes.
circuit_breakers.openai: Do not repeat paid inference attempts while credit_balance_exhausted remains the latest provider result.
circuit_breakers.openrouter: Do not attempt inference until a credential is bound through an approved secret-bearing execution surface.

selected_current_route.route: Repair the existing canonical Google WIF through an authenticated Google administration surface, then reuse Secret Manager, Federation operator and SOVARA gateway capability before creating any new control plane.
selected_current_route.why: This restores the greatest number of downstream capabilities while minimizing duplicated infrastructure.
